events.title: 애스턴 빌라 are left needing at least four points from their final two games after losing 2–1 to 아스널 at Highbury. 찰턴 애슬레틱's survival hopes take a hit when they lose 1–0 at home to 루턴 타운. 레스터 시티 are still in danger of going down after losing 3–1 at 첼시. 리버풀's title hopes are now fading fast after they are beaten 1–0 by the FA Cup finalists 코번트리 시티 at Highfield Road . 에버턴 are forced to wait for the title after being held to a goalless draw at home by a 맨체스터 시티 side whose survival challenge is still alive. A dead rubber match at Hillsborough sees 셰필드 웬즈데이 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 7–1. 더비 카운티 seal promotion to the First Division by beating 리즈 유나이티드 2–1 at the Baseball Ground. 포츠머스 beat 밀월 2–0 at Fratton Park, leaving them needing just a point from their final two league games to secure automatic promotion.

에버턴 secure the First Division title with a 1–0 win over 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road , despite 리버풀 beating 왓퍼드 1–0 at Anfield and 토트넘 홋스퍼 beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 4–0 at White Hart Lane . 애스턴 빌라's relegation is confirmed as they lose 2–1 at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이, but 맨체스터 시티 keep their survival hopes alive with a 1–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트. 찰턴 애슬레틱 move into the relegation playoff place by beating 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 3–0 on Tyneside , with 레스터 시티 dropping into the bottom three after being held to a 1–1 draw at home by local rivals 코번트리 시티. 포츠머스 are forced to wait for promotion to the First Division after losing 1–0 away to a 크리스털 팰리스 side who keep their playoff hopes alive in the process. Brighton and Hove Albion's 2–0 defeat at 브래드퍼드 시티 condemns them to relegation to the Third Division.

옥스퍼드 유나이티드 secure First Division survival with a 3–2 away win over 루턴 타운. 윔블던 are guaranteed a top 10 finish after beating 첼시 2–1 at Plough Lane . 올덤 애슬레틱's 2–0 defeat to 슈루즈버리 타운 at Gay Meadow sends 포츠머스 back into the First Division after a 28-year exile.
Relegated 애스턴 빌라 sack Billy McNeill after eight months as manager.

Ian Rush completes his 리버풀 career before signing for 유벤투스 by scoring in a 3–3 draw at 첼시. 노리치 시티 achieve the highest final position in their history when a 2–1 away win over 아스널 sees them finish fifth. 루턴 타운 also achieve their highest finish, securing seventh place in the final table despite a 3–1 defeat at 에버턴. 맨체스터 시티 go down after a 2–0 defeat at 웨스트햄 유나이티드, as do a 레스터 시티 side who could only manage a goalless draw at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are thrown a First Division lifeline when a 2–1 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스 ensures that they occupy the relegation play-off place in the final table. 더비 카운티 are crowned champions of the Second Division, while 그림즈비 타운 are relegated and 선덜랜드 finish in the relegation playoff place.
Champions 에버턴 finish their League campaign by beating third-placed 토트넘 홋스퍼 1–0.

코번트리 시티 win the first major trophy of their history with a 3–2 victory after extra time over 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the FA Cup final . A thrilling game had seen Clive Allen put 토트넘 홋스퍼 ahead in the second minute with his 49th goal of the season, only for Dave Bennett to equalise in the ninth minute. Gary Mabbutt restored 토트넘 홋스퍼's lead after 40 minutes, but Keith Houchen 's 64th-minute equaliser for 코번트리 시티 forced extra time. The winning goal came in the 96th minute, when Gary Mabbutt scored an own goal.

선덜랜드 are relegated to the Third Division for the first time in their history after being defeated on away goals in the Second Division relegation/Third Division promotion play-off semi-final by 질링엄 , who will take on 스윈던 타운 later this month to battle for a Second Division place. 볼턴 원더러스 go into the Fourth Division for the first time after suffering a similar humiliation at the hands of 올더숏 . More than 16,300 fans watch 울버햄프턴 원더러스 go through to the final, where they will face 올더숏 in a two-legged challenge for promotion to the Third Division.

Graham Taylor resigns after 11 years as 왓퍼드 manager to succeed Billy McNeill at relegated 애스턴 빌라. During his time at 왓퍼드, Taylor took the club from the Fourth Division to the First, finishing league runners-up in their first top flight season and reaching the FA Cup final in their second. 사우샘프턴 give a free transfer to their longest serving player Nick Holmes , the last remaining player from their 1976 FA Cup winning side .

Mel Machin is named as the new manager of relegated 맨체스터 시티, with his predecessor Jimmy Frizzell remaining at the club as his assistant. 애스턴 빌라 begin rebuilding following relegation with the sale of defender Tony Dorigo to 첼시 for £450,000.

질링엄 take a further step towards reaching the Second Division for the first time in their history by beating 스윈던 타운 1–0 at Priestfield in the first leg of the Third Division play-off final. 올더숏 gain a 2–0 advantage over 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at home in the Fourth Division contest.
찰턴 애슬레틱 beat 리즈 유나이티드 1–0 in the first leg of the play-off final for a place in the First Division next season.
맨스필드 타운 lift the Freight Rover Trophy by beating 브리스틀 시티 on penalties after a 1–1 draw at Wembley.

More than 31,000 fans watch 리즈 유나이티드 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 1–0 in the second leg of the contest for a place in next season's First Division, forcing a replay at a neutral venue. The same outcome materialises in the contest for a place in the Second Division, as 스윈던 타운 are now level with 질링엄 after winning the second leg of their contest 2–1 at the County Ground . Almost 20,000 fans pack the Molineux to watch 올더숏 beat 울버햄프턴 원더러스 to win promotion to the Third Division.
아스널 sign 윔블던 defender Nigel Winterburn for £405,000.

찰턴 애슬레틱 stay in the First Division after Peter Shirtliff scores twice in extra time to beat 리즈 유나이티드 2–1 in the play-off final replay at St Andrew's . 스윈던 타운 secure a second successive promotion by winning a replay of the Third Division final 2–0 against 질링엄 at the neutral venue of Selhurst Park.
